params.command: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match 'localtunnel' -and $_.CommandLine -match '--port\s+7443' -and $_.CommandLine -match '--local-host\s+127\.0\.0\.1' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine; $l=Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 7331,7443 } | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess,State; [ordered]@{tunnel=$p; listeners=$l} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
